newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse index dips in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse index dips in slow trading.

text.p: Shares on the Estonian stock market dipped on Monday amid relatively slow trade, dealers said.
Overall turnover on the main official list was 8.2 million kroons and the Tallinn stock exchange index slipped 0.10 percent to 109.15.
Forekspank was the most traded share on turnover of 2.24 million kroons and it closed lower at 75.50 kroons versus 75.95.
"Although there has been no bad news on Forekspank, its shares are under selling pressure," Savings Bank dealer Charlie Viikberg told Reuters.
Savings Bank itself had trade of 2.2 million kroons and it ended at 49.95 kroons versus 49.85.
Market leader Hansapank turned over two million kroons and it closed unchanged at 107.60.
The secondary free market had trade of 2.5 million kroons and the Rakvere meat processor was again the most traded on 883,000 kroons but it closed stable at 5.95 kroons.
